title: Disposable sample: Tavern conversation and wry intro seed

steps.label: welcome
steps.text: You are the Party Leader. Gather your adventurers here in Pineshire, then prepare to face the creatures threatening the Reach.

steps.label: Wry intro draft (disabled)
steps.text: Pineshire has a problem.

steps.label: Wry intro draft (disabled)
steps.text: The caves have monsters.

steps.label: Wry intro draft (disabled)
steps.text: The Tavern has heroes.

steps.label: Wry intro draft (disabled)
steps.text: Whether those heroes are any good is another matter.

steps.label: town tavern
steps.text: There’s talk of a tank looking for adventure. Visit the Tavern.

steps.label: hire garrick
steps.text: Garrick will join for free. Inspect his abilities if you like, then Hire for Free and confirm Hire.

steps.label: Sample: Bartender speaks
steps.text: [Sample placeholder] Introduce the Tavern and its willing adventurers.
steps.speaker: Bartender

steps.label: Sample: Garrick replies
steps.text: [Sample placeholder] Garrick replies. Replace this line with your own dialogue.
steps.speaker: Garrick

steps.label: prepare heroes
steps.text: Garrick is now in your roster. Open Manage Party and give him a place in the expedition.

steps.label: party fill
steps.text: Choose Garrick, a healer and three damage dealers. Keep your selections, or use Auto-Select.

steps.label: party save
steps.text: Five adventurers, ready for the road. Save Party to make this your expedition lineup.

steps.label: ready map
steps.text: The road is calling. Return to the World Map.

steps.label: slime select
steps.text: Something is stirring beneath the hills. Choose The Slime Cave.

steps.label: slime travel
steps.text: Follow the road to the Slime Cave. Tap Travel, then let the party make the journey.

steps.label: slime depart
steps.text: A six-wave expedition awaits, with camp before the boss. Your party is ready: Delve Deep!

steps.label: battle hud
steps.text: Into the cave! Your party fights on its own. The left-hand cards show Health and Mana; you direct their tactics.

steps.label: battle select
steps.text: Select Garrick by tapping his card or his figure on the battlefield.

steps.label: battle move
steps.text: A real warning is active. ACTION → Move, then choose clear ground for Garrick. Attack sends him back afterward.

steps.label: battle attack
steps.text: Send your selected hero back into the fight: tap a live enemy to Attack.

steps.label: camp
steps.text: Camp: Leave keeps banked rewards; Farm repeats a cleared wave. Face Boss when you’re ready.

steps.label: boss interrupt
steps.text: ACTION → Interrupt → casting Sovereign.

steps.label: Sample: live boss cue planning
steps.text: [Sample placeholder] Boss landing has no supported cue event. Select combat.mechanic.warning for a genuine live warning; preview does not create a boss or complete this lesson.

steps.label: victory
steps.text: The cave is cleared! Your real rewards and level gains are saved. Return to the World Map.

steps.label: return select
steps.text: Victorious, we return to Pineshire. Choose the town.

steps.label: return travel
steps.text: Travel back to Pineshire. Your loot and earned experience stay with you.

steps.label: complete
steps.text: Your first adventure is complete. Equipment compares your finds; ? offers optional help. Choose your next road.

steps.label: leader tap
steps.text: Tap the highlighted ordinary enemy to deal Leader damage.

steps.label: groups
steps.text: SELECT → Melee commands your close-range heroes together. Use groups when several heroes need the same order.

steps.label: formations
steps.text: Spread separates a group against area attacks. Stack gathers it at a point; Hold keeps its position. Try them when useful. This explanation does not record mastery.

steps.label: tactics
steps.text: Renown grows through milestones. Each tactic shows its cost and requirement. Choose Restore to browse healing; no purchase is needed.

steps.label: tiko_welcome_1
steps.text: Welcome to Pineshire! I'd offer you a proper welcome, but we've got a bit of a slime problem.
steps.speaker: Tiko

steps.label: tiko_welcome_2
steps.text: The blasted things are pouring in from the north. Our guards are holding them back, but I don't know how much longer they'll last.
steps.speaker: Tiko

steps.label: tiko_welcome_3
steps.text: Say... you look like someone who can handle themselves. Ever led a party before?
steps.speaker: Tiko

steps.label: tiko_welcome_4
steps.text: I've got a few adventurers in my tavern itching for a fight. Come on, there's someone you should meet.
steps.speaker: Tiko

steps.label: tavern_garrick_1
steps.text: This is Garrick. Tough as nails, and he's agreed to help us. Why don't you introduce yourself?
steps.speaker: Tiko

steps.label: tavern_garrick_2
steps.text: Name's Garrick. I've fought worse than a few oversized puddles. Though I'll admit, there's a lot of 'em.
steps.speaker: Garrick

steps.label: tavern_garrick_3
steps.text: And he's not asking for a single coin! Says he'd rather fight than stand around watching Pineshire fall.
steps.speaker: Tiko

steps.label: tavern_garrick_4
steps.text: You call the shots, I'll hold the line. So, are we doing this?
steps.speaker: Garrick

steps.label: tavern_garrick_5
steps.text:
You two go ahead.  Best of luck!

[Recruit Garrick - Free]
steps.speaker: Tiko

steps.label: garrick_heroes_1
steps.text: Good. Let's get to work. I've got a few friends willing to join the fight. Come on, I'll introduce you.
steps.speaker: Garrick

steps.label: garrick_heroes_2
steps.text: These are Chaska and Durgrim.  They like to get close up and personal with their enemies.  Best leave them room to work.
steps.speaker: Garrick

steps.label: garrick_heroes_3
steps.text: Let them see me coming.  Fear makes the hunter sweeter!
steps.speaker: Chaska

steps.label: garrick_heroes_4
steps.text: Hah! Ye can have the hunt, I'll take a firm footing and somethin' worth hittin'!
steps.speaker: Durgrim

steps.label: garrick_heroes_5
steps.text: Orwen and Selenne can fight from farther back. Give them some space, and they’ll make good use of it.
steps.speaker: Garrick

steps.label: garrick_heroes_6
steps.text: Less noise back there. Easier to see what’s coming.
steps.speaker: Orwen

steps.label: garrick_heroes_7
steps.text: And to ensure it never reaches us. Ideally.
steps.speaker: Selenne

steps.label: garrick_heroes_8
steps.text: Go ahead and tap Manage Party.
steps.speaker: Garrick

steps.label: garrick_heroes_9
steps.text: This is where you'll set up our party.  I’m coming with you since you need a Tank. Add me first.
steps.speaker: Garrick

steps.label: garrick_heroes_10
steps.text: To save time, you can click the Auto-Select option to fill the rest of the party slots.
steps.speaker: Garrick

steps.label: New dialogue
steps.text: There we are. Save the party, and let’s get moving.
steps.speaker: Garrick

steps.label: New dialogue
steps.text: Slimes took over that cave a while back. Dark, damp, nobody bothering them. We’re about to spoil that last part.
steps.speaker: Garrick
